lines.ar: وَلَا بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا أَبَدًا
lines.en: or anything of this worldly life, [ever.]
then that is from {Allah's bounty} upon you.

source: Shaykh Muhammad ibn Salih al-Uthaymin, Sharh Riyad as-Salihin (on hadith 7, Sahih Muslim 2564)
quranEn: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
hadithAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
hadithEn: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
